display_name: DURA 四阶统计同记录排序源训练
description: 匹配四阶统计基线架构与预算，在合法源配对 IQ 上额外优化功率与四阶统计的同物理记录排序。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU7 deterministic FP32 TF32off; source IQ and frozen DURA context only, GPU restoration with frozen CPU reader, CPU truth-last

data.version: fixed source training cache epochs21/22/23; source diagnostic epoch19
data.representation: Paired source received/clean and frozen DURA output/physical variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Source-only 64-record real-DURA optimizer smoke and 112-source-record frozen-reader preflight; no target

permissions.claim_scope: F-free/TX-label-free paired source IQ training; F used only in separate source no-query preflight and frozen ground evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh same-seed 14966274-parameter cumulant model plus original frozen DURA; no weights copied from matched control
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original frozen DURA source context cache, exact 32768 source IDs and three aligned source views, no F/TX/V/target in G training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: New same-seed independent training from scratch, no reused control checkpoint, legal source IQ and fixed DURA only
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch20 and fixed training objective; no target or source-score selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU7 one this-task worker per GPU stage, >=8192 MiB free and fewer than 3 total GPU apps; preserve existing GPU3/5/6 and other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner on source role or contract mismatch, nonfinite output, wrong checkpoint, target or F/TX leakage, output collision, failed source no-query smoke, or systemic technical failure; preserve other owners and artifacts.

metric_names: source IQ and DURA guard loss

rows.method: Matched cumulant model with additional .002 same-physical-record logsumexp ranking on standardized source power and cumulant descriptors, temperature .5, duplicate views positive
rows.purpose: Train only on authorized source paired IQ; no F/TX/V/target input
rows.seed_notes: Model seed 2026110901; source fit 2026110611; training order 2026110902; evaluation 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: 14966274 trainable + 266951 frozen DURA; same 32768 source IDs x 3 views x 20 epochs, batch32; first 512 source clean IDs normalize training features

notes: Matched cumulant control: same seed 2026110901, source fit, order, budget and architecture; independent fresh initialization, additional source-record ranking only.
Ranking distinguishes same physical record, not transmitter identity; other different records may share TX, and clean reference used only during source training.
TX/F/V/target are never read in restoration training; fixed final20 then seven predictions before independent truth-last.
Historical Phase1 ground test is exposed; single seed is not a blind or real satellite result.
